declarations: Method: C5 new high after a normal pullback in an established uptrend; Pivotal Point = 20-bar high / last swing high on the MTF grid (C17, C19)
danger_signal_threshold: TRANSLATED as a one-day reaction of 1x atr_14d off the day's high, my translation, not the literal 6 points (C7, C18-C20)
mp_state read as my six-column analogue, not identical (C18); fill_difficulty NOT_SERVED (day_vol is a proxy); volume, group rank, flow, coil, insti_money and divergence are not my tests
R1: no bracket field is a basis for any ruling; R41: no Valen flag cited

rulings.evidence: day_vol 0.86 is a weight, not my test (fill_difficulty NOT_SERVED). Price is at the high: daily HH/HL 0.9% over its swing high, 1.3% under the 20-day and 20-wk highs, close at 88% of the hour's day range (C5).

tf.W: LH but HL, 13.4% over swing high, 1.3% under 20-wk high: trend up
tf.D: HH/HL, 0.9% above swing high: new-high zone after a reaction
tf.H1: HH/HL, 88% of range: no danger signal

rulings.evidence: New high at the pivot: daily HH/HL 0.0% above its swing high, 0.2% under the 20-day and 20-wk highs, hourly at 91% of the day's range. The C5 shape after a reaction; weekly LH/LL is the weight.

tf.W: LH/LL but 0.2% under 20-wk high: at the high, swing class lagging
tf.D: HH/HL, at the swing high, 0.2% under 20-day high: the C5 entry
tf.H1: HH/HL, 91% of range: closing strong, no danger signal

rulings.evidence: Falling frames: weekly EMA 9<21, 19.0% under the 20-wk high; daily 9<21 with swing LH/LL. A 98%-of-range day inside a Downward Trend is a Natural Rally, not trend resumption (C5a, C18).

tf.W: 9<21, 19.0% under 20-wk high: Downward Trend
tf.D: 9<21, LH/LL, 0.1% under 20-day high: rally inside a downtrend
tf.H1: HH but LL, 98% of range: strong hour only

rulings.evidence: Bunched averages are not a new high: weekly 7.1% under its swing high, daily swing LH/LL, hourly closed at 0% of the day's range. A stock that cannot make new highs is grounds to revise (C14, C5).

tf.W: HH/HL but 7.1% under swing high: prior high not cleared
tf.D: LH/LL, 3.0% under 20-day high: no follow-through
tf.H1: 0% of the day's range: closed at the low

rulings.evidence: A shallow pullback is the one thing C5 says never to buy. W and D HH/HL is true, but close is 5.2% under the 20-day and 20-wk highs and the hourly is below EMA9: the reaction is not over.

tf.W: HH/HL, 4.4% under swing high: uptrend, no new high
tf.D: HH/HL, 5.2% under 20-day high: inside the pullback
tf.H1: below EMA9, 53% of range: no trigger

rulings.evidence: Weekly swing LH/LL, 3.9% under the 20-wk high; the hourly closed at 6% of the day's range and below EMA9 after the break. No fast follow-through after the pivot is itself a warning (C17, C5a).

tf.W: LH/LL: no established Upward Trend
tf.D: HH/HL, 5.6% over swing high, 3.9% under 20-day high: not a new high
tf.H1: below EMA9, 6% of range: break faded into the close

rulings.evidence: Daily HH/HL is true, but weekly LH/LL and the hourly at 6% of the day's range under EMA9 show the break did not hold into the close (C17). Participation is not my test.

tf.W: LH/LL, 3.9% under 20-wk high
tf.D: HH/HL, 3.9% under 20-day high
tf.H1: below EMA9, 6% of range: weak close

rulings.evidence: Distance from a long average is not a danger signal for me; C7/C20 need a stall then a reaction. Weekly and daily HH/HL, EMA 9>21 on all frames; close 7.0% under the 20-day high is a normal reaction. I act only on the new high.

tf.W: HH/HL, 87.2% above swing high: leader in an established trend
tf.D: HH/HL, 7.0% under 20-day high: normal reaction, wait for the high
tf.H1: 96% of range, 0.2% under 20-hr high: no danger signal

rulings.evidence: Above resistance fails my test: weekly swing LH/LL, 3.0% under the 20-wk high; daily HH but LL, 2.1% under its swing high and 20-day high. No new high in an Upward Trend (C5a). adx is not my field.

tf.W: LH/LL, 3.0% under 20-wk high: lower highs
tf.D: HH but LL, 2.1% under swing high: not cleared
tf.H1: LH/LL, 73% of range

rulings.evidence: Breaking a lower weekly swing high by 2.9% is not clearing the Pivotal Point: still 3.0% under the 20-wk high, weekly class LH/LL, daily 2.1% under its swing high (C19).

tf.W: 2.9% over a lower swing high, 3.0% under 20-wk high: not the pivot
tf.D: HH but LL, 2.1% under 20-day high
tf.H1: LH/LL, 73% of range

rulings.evidence: Weekly EMA 9<21 and swing LH/LL, 8.4% under the 20-wk high: a break of a lower weekly swing high inside a Downward Trend is a Natural Rally, not resumption (C5a, C18).

tf.W: 9<21, LH/LL, 8.4% under 20-wk high: Downward Trend
tf.D: HH but LL, 0.2% under 20-day high: rally off a low
tf.H1: HH/HL, 95% of range: strong hour only

rulings.evidence: mp STRONG/ACCELERATING reads as a rally column, but weekly swing LH/LL and the daily 6.8% under its 20-day high show no Upward Trend and no new high (C5a, C18).

tf.W: LH/LL, 6.8% under 20-wk high: no uptrend
tf.D: HH/HL, 6.8% under 20-day high: inside a reaction
tf.H1: HH/HL, 72% of range, 6.6% under swing high

rulings.evidence: mp STRONG/ACCELERATING without the high: weekly HH but LL and daily both 6.6% under their 20-bar highs. Strength off a base that has not cleared its Pivotal Point (C5, C19).

tf.W: HH but LL, 6.6% under 20-wk high
tf.D: HH/HL, 11.5% over swing high, 6.6% under 20-day high: not cleared
tf.H1: LH but HL, 65% of range

rulings.evidence: Dip-and-reclaim is a pullback buy (C5 forbids). Weekly LH but HL, 4.3% under its swing high and 6.4% under the 20-wk high: no established Upward Trend for the daily thrust to resume.

tf.W: LH but HL, 6.4% under 20-wk high: higher frame not up
tf.D: HH/HL, 17.2% above swing high: rally off a low
tf.H1: LH/LL, 84% of range

rulings.evidence: Above daily resistance, but weekly 6.4% under the 20-wk high and 4.3% under its swing high: the higher-timeframe Pivotal Point is not cleared (C19, C5a). Volume, flow and RS rank are not my tests.

tf.W: LH but HL, 4.3% under swing high: not cleared
tf.D: HH/HL, 1.2% under 20-day high: short-term break
tf.H1: LH/LL, 8.6% over swing high, 84% of range

rulings.evidence: Volume, flow and group rank are not my tests; extension is a weight. Weekly HH/HL 15.3% over its swing high, 2.4% under the 20-wk high: an Upward Trend near its high, SWK the second name (C5, C14).

tf.W: HH/HL, 2.4% under 20-wk high: established uptrend at the high
tf.D: HH but LL, 14.9% over swing high, 2.4% under 20-day high
tf.H1: HH but LL, 77% of range: no danger signal

rulings.evidence: A base under the pivot is not my entry: close 6.5% under the weekly swing high and 20-wk high, 3.5% under the daily swing high. I buy the new high, never ahead of it (C5, C19).

tf.W: HH/HL, 6.5% under swing high: uptrend, prior high not cleared
tf.D: HH/HL, 3.5% under swing high: inside the base
tf.H1: LH but HL, 37% of range

rulings.evidence: The trend leg my C5a needs is there: weekly and daily swing HH/HL, EMA 9>21 on all frames. The new-high leg is not: 6.5% under the 20-wk high, so I stay aside until it prints.

tf.W: HH/HL, 9>21: Upward Trend established
tf.D: HH/HL, 3.5% under 20-day high: reaction not over
tf.H1: LH but HL, 37% of range: no trigger

rulings.evidence: Not a buy now, on my own evidence: hourly below EMA9 with 9<21, daily 2.4% under its swing high and 2.9% under the 20-day high: the reaction is not over (C5). Group rank, volume, divergence not my tests.

tf.W: HH/HL, 2.9% under 20-wk high: uptrend intact
tf.D: HH/HL, 2.4% under swing high: no new high
tf.H1: below EMA9, 9<21: short-term trend rolling over

rulings.evidence: day_vol 0.86, coil and insti_money are not my tests. Weekly HH/HL 6.7% over its swing high, daily 2.2% over its swing high, 2.9% under the 20-day high: a normal reaction near the high in an Upward Trend (C5, C8).

tf.W: HH/HL, 2.9% under 20-wk high: established uptrend
